items.body:
A debut, digital-only EP from a Danish trio, led by one of the Nordic folk scene�s outstanding and experienced vocalists, Mia Guldhammer. Five tracks, with the musicians bringing their own perspectives to mostly traditional music. There�s a lovely ancient, creaky mood throughout.
The opener, �Svennedal,� with its rough, cantering rhythm, offers a perfect shop window for Guldhammer�s impressive, persuasive voice, while jaw harp and bagpipes bring an insistent propulsion to �Nordg�rd,� the only original here, by band member Morten Musicus.
Cimbalom adds a delicate backdrop to the traditional �Agnete Of Bjergmanden,� with Guldhammer�s soft jaw harp offering extra textures to the other instruments, as it brings a springy opening to the final cut, �Orms�,� mingling with flute and strings to create something quite thrilling and off kilter on this instrumental.
Five tracks, and an introduction to a band that already seems very mature and accomplished. A strong beginning � what will GuldGanger do with an entire album?
items.label: Go' Danish Folk Music
items._cn_summary: 这是一张由丹麦三人组合GuldGanger发行的数字EP，由北欧民谣圈内资深歌手Mia Guldhammer领衔。五首曲目以传统素材为主，演奏者各自带来不同视角，开篇曲以粗犷的奔跑节奏展示主唱声音的说服力，口簧与风笛在唯一原创曲中提供强劲推进力，钦巴龙琴为传统曲目铺设细腻底色，末曲以口簧与笛弦交织出不安分却扣人心弦的器乐篇章。五首作品呈现出乐队超出新人水准的成熟度，作为首张作品虽篇幅有限，却已勾勒出鲜明的艺术方向：古旧质感与非常规编配并置，传统与即兴元素自然交融。整体定位偏向北欧民俗传统领域，跨类型融合程度有限，但对于关注世界音乐的听众而言，这张EP展示了丹麦当代民间音乐场景中一种值得关注的声音探索路径。

items.body: Kr�ta , the latest release on Norway's Taragot label, features a Swede and two Norwegians playing interpretations of mainly traditional tunes from their respective countries. Fiddler Mats Ed�n has long been involved in Swedish folk music, as a player, composer and teacher, and in the process exploring and integrating different musical styles and approaches. Tellef Kvifte was in the pioneering Norwegian crossover band Slinkombas in the 1970s and has continued to play a central role in Norwegian folk music, both as a musician and an academic. Most often heard playing the sj�fl�yte , more widely known as a recorder, Kvifte has employed other instruments from outside the Norwegian tradition, in particular the saxophone and bagpipes. His son Knut Kvifte Nesheim , a drummer and composer, has also shown a determination to blur the lines between different musical genres, both in his solo and group projects. Kr�ta by Ed�n/Kvifte/Nesheim trio It comes as no surprise then to find this trio offering a far from conventional take on the tunes they have chosen. While dance tunes may be the source of most of the material here, this feels more akin to chamber music; not that it is remotely classical in style, but in the sense it conveys of three players engrossed in a musically intimate conversation. This is not a performance appropriate for accompanying dancers but might instead be seen as an exploration of hidden possibilities of meaning in the music. In so doing it reveals some of its underlying mystery, including, perhaps, a darker side. Just as in an Ibsen play, where the surface bonhomie, jollity and social nicety can be hiding something more sinister, in Scandinavian dance music there are at times hints of a troublesome undercurrent below the surface. So the decision to open proceedings with �Fossgrimen,� a fiddle tune from Norway's Setesdal valley, is perhaps significant. A fossgrimen is a mythical creature, a kind of water-sprite living in waterfalls from whom fiddle-players were considered to have learned their skills and for that were not universally welcomed, with the fiddle considered to be the devil's instrument. Kr�ta by Ed�n/Kvifte/Nesheim trio Tellef Kvifte takes the lead melody on most tracks but on the Swedish �Polska from Per Myhr,� having played a repeated introductory riff on the sj�fl�yte, with Mats Ed�n providing an amorphous textural accompaniment below and Nesheim adding some quiet tinkling, it's Ed�n who introduces the tune on the fiddle with Kvifte proceeding to play in unison. It's a short track and almost as soon as it gets going things start to fragment and everything grind to a halt.

items._genre: Nordic folk / chamber improvisation / experimental folk
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由瑞典小提琴家与两位挪威乐手组成三重奏，对斯堪的纳维亚传统舞曲进行重新诠释。乐评指出其演奏方式更接近室内乐而非舞蹈伴奏音乐，三位乐手沉浸在亲密的音乐对话中，探索旋律中隐藏的可能性与更深层的含义。评论特别提到专辑以挪威塞特斯达尔地区的小提琴曲《Fossgrimen》开篇，暗示民间传说中关于水妖与魔鬼乐器的暗流。在曲目《Polska from Per Myhr》中，recorder引入重复引子后由小提琴主导旋律，但音乐迅速碎片化并戛然而止，展现出一种打破传统的即兴解构手法。整体呈现一种将北欧民间素材进行抽象化、实验性处理的探索态度。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."
items._genre: field recording / spoken word / documentary / sound art
items._cn_summary: 这不是一张传统意义上的音乐专辑，而是由录音师Ian Brennan在芝加哥南区街头录制的枪支暴力幸存者口述合集。二十五位参与者年龄从十七岁到六十七岁不等，多数人就来自录音所在的街区，其中穿插freestyle说唱段落。文章明确指出录音中未添加任何音乐元素，全部声音来自现场环境，包括飞机降落声、街头环境音。地点选在一位九十四岁祖母家的前廊，附近就有流浪犬出没。编辑放弃了常规乐评形式，直接呈现录音师的简短说明与现场素材。一位失去两个儿子的老年女性在讲述中情绪崩溃，反复道歉，而文章将歉意的对象指向社会本身。专辑收益将捐赠给致力于以公共卫生方法终结暴力的Cure Violence Global组织。这是一件介于田野录音、社会文献与声音艺术之间的作品，对关注实验声音、社会议题与芝加哥南区历史的听众具有特殊价值。

items.body: EXAUDI Pocket Universe Four pieces by Cassandra Miller, Andrew Hamilton, Leo Chadburn and Geoff Hannan under the baton of conductor James Weeks Curation is everywhere nowadays: from art biennales to food menus, everything has abespoke theme, bolstered by snazzy presentation, marketing ploys and influencer campaigns. But what happens when you release music without a thematic lynchpin holding things together? Such is the case of Pocket Universe, the most recent offering from the vocal ensemble EXAUDI and conductor James Weeks, released on NMC Recordings. It comprises four pieces by Cassandra Miller, Andrew Hamilton, Leo Chadburn and Geoff Hannan, commissioned by EXAUDI’s annual EXPOSURE showcase between 2013 and 2019. Conceptually, that doesn’t whet the appetite. While the booklet cites a few similarities between the works –... The post EXAUDI – Pocket Universe appeared first on The Quietus.

items._cn_summary: EXAUDI 声乐合奏团在指挥 James Weeks 执棒下推出专辑《Pocket Universe》，收录 Cassandra Miller、Andrew Hamilton、Leo Chadburn 与 Geoff Hannan 四位作曲家于 2013 至 2019 年间为该团年度 EXPOSURE 委约计划创作的作品，由 NMC Recordings 厂牌发行。乐评围绕策展式专辑组织方式展开探讨，指出当代音乐发行普遍依赖主题线索与营销包装，而这张专辑缺乏统摄性的主题框架。评论引用了内页小册子中提到的几处作品间相似性，但正文在关键分析处被截断，未能深入展开对具体作曲技法、声乐处理或配器策略的讨论，使读者难以获得对各作品音乐语言的实质了解。整体而言，这是一张面向当代古典乐迷的委约作品集合，聚焦新生代作曲家的声乐写作探索。

items.body: Review by Abrasmatheus — Wish You Were Here is one of those albums that does not need to be excessively complex to feel progressive. Released in 1975, it combines progressive rock, psychedelic rock, art rock and space rock into an incredibly cohesive and atmospheric experience. I would not consider it one of Pink Floyd's most overtly progressive albums, but its careful compositions, long instrumental developments, experimental production and thematic coherence make it a very strong progressive rock work.The atmosphere is probably the album's greatest strength. It is contemplative, melancholic, emotional and, at times, almost intellectual in the way its themes are presented. The production has aged remarkably well, with every instrument occupying its own space in the mix. The synthesizers and keyboards of Richard Wright are particularly impressive, adding an essential dimension to the album's sound.The centerpiece is undoubtedly "Shine On You Crazy Diamond", which I consider a masterpiece in its own right. I prefer to experience its different sections as one complete work rather than treating them as separate pieces. The song contains excellent instrumental development, especially in the guitars, drums and synthesizers. David Gilmour's guitar work is outstanding, combining technical ability with an enormous amount of emotional expression. Wright's keyboards are equally important, creating much of the psychedelic and spacious atmosphere that defines the piece.The emotional weight of "Shine On You Crazy Diamond" is also increased by its connection to Syd Barrett, whose work with Pink Floyd I greatly admire. Knowing that the song was written as a tribute to him gives the piece an additional emotional dimension. The feeling of loss and nostalgia is deeply present without overwhelming the music itself."Welcome to the Machine" is another major highlight. Its synthesizer work is simply magnificent, and the electronic textures create an almost mechanical atmosphere that perfectly complements the song's subject matter. The composition is less progressive in a traditional structural sense, but its sound design and atmosphere are remarkably creative. I would give the synthesizers an almost absurd 10/10 ? or, jokingly, 1,000,000/10. This is one of the clearest examples of how Pink Floyd could use studio production itself as part of the composition.The lyrics also contribute considerably to the album's thematic unity. Alongside the tribute to Syd Barrett, the record deals with the music industry and the way it can become destructive and dehumanizing. "Welcome to the Machine" and "Have a Cigar" are particularly effective in this regard. Even though these themes were written in the 1970s, they remain strikingly relevant today."Have a Cigar" is another very enjoyable track. Roy Harper's vocals work surprisingly well and have some similarities to Roger Waters' voice. The song is more accessible than some of the album's other material, but it still fits naturally into the overall concept.The title track, "Wish You Were Here", is probably the most commercially accessible song on the album. I personally rate it slightly below the other tracks, at 7/10, but it still serves an important role in the album as a whole. Its lyrics and emotional character provide another perspective on the themes of absence, loss and alienation.One of the things I appreciate most about Wish You Were Here is how naturally the tracks connect to each other. The album can almost feel like one long composition, rather than simply a collection of individual songs. The transitions, recurring atmosphere and production choices create an unusually strong sense of unity.From a progressive perspective, I would describe the album as moderately progressive. It is not constantly concerned with complex time signatures, virtuosity or extremely elaborate structures. Instead, its progressive qualities come from the development of ideas, extended instrumental passages, experimentation with sound, thematic coherence and the willingness to let atmosphere become a fundamental part of the composition.The instrumentation is excellent throughout. Gilmour's guitars are a major highlight, Wright's keyboards and synthesizers are perhaps the most distinctive element of the album for me, Nick Mason's drumming contributes effectively to the long developments, and the saxophone adds another color to the sound. The engineering and production are also outstanding, particularly in the way the instruments and effects are separated and integrated into the overall soundscape.The album's strongest qualities are "Shine On You Crazy Diamond," Richard Wright's synthesizers and keyboards, and David Gilmour's guitars and vocals. I honestly don't have any significant weaknesses to point out. Even though "Wish You Were Here" itself is the most commercial track and the one I personally rate lowest, it is still an important part of the complete experience.Overall, Wish You Were Here is an album in which you can become completely absorbed in the atmosphere of the music. It is contemplative, melancholic, psychedelic and emotionally powerful, while remaining carefully composed and remarkably cohesive.Alongside Meddle and Atom Heart Mother, it is among my favorite Pink Floyd albums.Essential for anyone interested in atmospheric and psychedelic progressive rock.

items._cn_summary: 这张1975年的专辑将前卫摇滚、迷幻摇滚、艺术摇滚和太空摇滚融合为高度统一的氛围体验。评论者认为其并非Pink Floyd最具前卫色彩的专辑，但凭借精心构建的编曲、绵长的器乐发展、实验性录音制作以及主题上的高度统一，仍是前卫摇滚领域的坚实作品。氛围是专辑最大的优势——沉思、忧郁而富于情感张力，录音制作经得起时间检验，Richard Wright的合成器为整体声音增添了关键维度。核心曲目' Shine On You Crazy Diamond'被视作一部完整的器乐杰作，Gilmour的吉他与Wright的键盘在延展的段落中交替推进，承载着对Syd Barrett的怀念之情。'Welcome to the Machine'以合成器音色构建机械化质感，'Have a Cigar'则借助Roy Harper的客串演唱批判音乐工业。整张专辑围绕音乐工业的异化主题展开，歌词在数十年后仍具现实意义。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — The surname Gildenl'w is by no means unfamiliar to us. There's no need to explain why here. But it might be worth dwelling a bit on his first name. Born in Sweden, Kristoffer was the bassist for Pain of Salvation up until the double album *Be* (2004), and like most bassists, his demeanor was more low-key at the time, and his role seemingly less prominent than that of his brother, the frontman. Can we then speak of emancipation? Or simply of a search for another form of personal fulfillment? In any case, in 2003, at the height of the famous progressive metal band's popularity, Kristoffer left Sweden and Pain of Salvation to move to the Netherlands, collaborating on both sides of the Atlantic with some heavyweights of the progressive rock scene (Damien Wilson, Neal Morse, Lana Lane, the band Kayak'), before launching a solo career in 2012 with the album *Rust*.Begun in 2019 (alongside the album *Homebound*), *Empty*, Kristoffer Gildenl'w's fifth and latest solo album, was originally scheduled for 2020, but a devastating pandemic had other plans, and an unexpected *Let Me Be A Ghost* took precedence, releasing in 2021. Despite its overarching theme (depression), the album *Let Me Be A Ghost* still contained beautiful moments of musical serenity, a touch of melodic and harmonic lightness, as if weightless. There was gravity, too, but it knew how to be playful at times. And this ghostly imprint ultimately led to a kind of peace. 'Let Me Be A Ghost' seemed to describe the sensation of falling'but a fall from which one gets back up, with difficulty, not without effort, yet with courage and the feeling of having grown.'Empty' is even more striking because it offers a broader critical perspective on another tragic fall'that of humanity, drawn into the emptiness of our existence. The music thus becomes the anxious echo of a palpable despair that conveys the state of mind of a man struggling not to fall into this void'this vast, searing void that weighs on our hearts, terrified at the thought of what humanity is doing, a lost humanity in search of meaning.Like his previous solo albums, *Empty* possesses the same strange power of attraction'an irresistible pull that draws us entirely into a universe poised between dream and reality, between soothing light and revealing darkness. How can one resist lyrics so beautiful, so poignant'all these words that soar directly toward the heavens, sung in that deep, comforting, instantly recognizable voice that speaks of disarray, doubt, the pain of incomprehension in the face of human beings' self-destructive recklessness'a voice that speaks to us of our fears and sufferings as fragile beings, just as one might speak to a damned soul waiting in vain for its due.Despite all, one senses the presence of a mystery'a reflection on our purpose in life'carried by Kristoffer Gildenl'w's music and the brilliant artists who perform it. Each composition is a bewildering showcase of beauty, set to restrained vocals, but that is precisely what makes Kristoffer's style so powerful and heightens the emotional vertigo it evokes in us. Each track on his album is a profound and expansive anthem that can help us endure all the torments of the world. We can sense echoes of his former band. We can sense his love for Joni Mitchell, Mike Oldfield, and other giants of the '70s. We hear echoes of Anathema or Dire Straits. We encounter heart-wrenching blues ' la Pink Floyd, the kind whose mysteries were known only to Gilmour and Waters when they were still able to get along. It is dark and dense music, yet it regularly lightens, expands, shakes itself free, moves, and brightens'notably thanks to the graceful arabesques of Ben Mathot and Anne Bakker's violins, a rhythm section capable of softening its touch, the enchanting piano arpeggios played by Kristoffer himself, or the memorable feverish surges of the electric guitar tamed by sorcerers who seem to command the waves and the flames; all these warm notes like so many stars burning eternally to soothe our nights.*Empty* is one of those rich and profound progressive rock works that give us all the more the more we bring of ourselves to them as we receive them'intuitively felt by the heart yet always surprising to the ear. By giving us the best of himself here'which requires great courage' Kristoffer Gildenl'w sets an example by casting an intense light into the night of our troubled souls, illuminating with irrepressible hope a reality before which the malevolent structures of our destructive imagination and our death-dealing impulses dissolve'the only true light, the one that seeks to purify us of our unforgivable sins committed against Mother Nature. In the end, 'Empty' is neither sad nor despairing. In any case, even in the face of impending disaster, there will always be something good to take away'if only a tiny drop of happiness or a pinch of love.
items._genre: crossover prog / progressive rock / art rock
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是瑞典贝斯手Kristoffer Gildenlöw的第五张个人作品，以抑郁症与人类存在空虚为主题展开概念化叙事。音乐延续了他从Pain of Salvation以来的低调用色，贝斯线条沉稳内敛，歌词充满对人性自我毁灭的反思与精神追问。评论指出专辑在梦境与现实、安抚之光与揭示之暗之间游走，每首作品都呈现出复杂的美学层次，旋律与和声在沉郁中保有空灵的透亮感。演奏者阵容精良，作品在情绪重量与旋律呼吸之间取得了值得注意的平衡，整体气质偏向内省冥想式的艺术摇滚路线，对于偏好前卫摇滚及概念专辑的听众具有持续的吸引力。

items.body: Zwickau’s Elektrisch Festival returns on 24 October 2026 with a line-up that makes a convincing argument for electronic music as a continuum rather than a museum of separate generations. At one end stands Portion Control, active since 1979 and fundamental to the development of British industrial electronics; around them are Hungarian EBM veterans Escalator, the much newer KRIEG-B, and the contemporary projects OSZYLAYTER and Cyborg Projekt X. The 19th Elektrisch Festival takes place at Club Seilerstraße, Seilerstraße 1B, 08056 Zwickau. Doors open at 19:00, with the programme beginning at 20:00. The final line-up announced by organiser emmobiz Records is Portion Control, Escalator, OSZYLAYTER, Cyborg Projekt X and KRIEG-B. A festival with a rather unusual history Elektrisch is not a newly invented festival carrying an impressive number. Its history reaches back well before the current revival. Contemporary reports document the 11th edition in 2007, the 12th in 2008, the 13th in 2009, and two editions, numbers 14 and 15, in 2010, then held at Zwickau’s BPM Club. Artists appearing during that period included names such as Absolute Body Control, Birmingham 6, Tyske Ludder and The Klinik. Then Elektrisch disappeared for fourteen years. emmobiz Records revived it in 2024 with the 16th Elektrisch Festival, now at Club Seilerstraße. That return was already sold out months in advance and brought together Calva Y Nada, Cat Rapes Dog, Digital Factor and Accessory. The 17th edition followed in October 2025 with Test Dept, NZ, In Strict Confidence, Supreme Court and To Avoid. In February 2026, the 18th Elektrisch expanded across two evenings, separating a synthpop-oriented first night from a harder EBM/electro programme on the second. That history makes the 2026 autumn line-up apt: Elektrisch has repeatedly connected artists from different phases of underground electronic music instead of reducing EBM to one historical period. Portion Control The obvious historical heavyweight is Portion Control. Formed in London in 1979, the group emerged from the early British industrial-electronic underground and became important for its use of synthesisers, drum machines and sampling long before those methods became standard practice. Their influence has subsequently been acknowledged in connection with artists including Skinny Puppy, Front Line Assembly, Nine Inch Nails, Orbital and Nitzer Ebb; they also toured with Depeche Mode in 1984. But calling Portion Control a heritage act would miss what remains interesting about them. They returned in the 2000s and have continued producing new work rather than maintaining the early catalogue. This August they released “1983-86 – Hit The Pulse to Purge…”, their first major Artoffact archival box, while their official site simultaneously continues to define the project rather succinctly as “uncompromising dark electronic audio.” Zwickau is currently one of only two forthcoming live appearances listed on their Bandcamp. Escalator Escalator brings another kind of history to the evening. The Hungarian project was founded in Budapest in 1988 by 2RT+TB and belongs to the late-’80s/early-’90s generation of European Electronic Body Music. Its musical roots lie in the harder intersection of EBM and industrial electronics, with early influences including Kraftwerk, Throbbing Gristle, Cabaret Voltaire, Clock DVA and Front 242. Escalator’s history has been anything but linear; long gaps between releases and activity have been part of the project, yet its work has remained closely associated with the physical, stripped-back mechanics of classic body music. Their presence next to Portion Control is more than an “old-school” pairing: the two acts come from different geographical and chronological points in the development of electronic body music. OSZYLAYTER The German OSZYLAYTER represents a much more recent strand of the line-up. Public biographical information on the project is relatively sparse, so it is better not to manufacture a grand history that isn’t there. What can be verified is a growing Bandcamp catalogue including “Hate This Day”, “Lover Boy”, “Free Girls” and “Dig It in the Dirt”, while current Elektrisch coverage places the project on the modern dark-electro/industrial side of the bill. In the context of Elektrisch, that relative newness is actually useful. This isn’t five bands demonstrating variations of exactly the same established EBM formula; OSZYLAYTER helps shift the evening toward newer club electronics and shows where some of those older physical principles have travelled. Cyborg Projekt X Cyborg Projekt X is similarly one of the less extensively documented names on the programme. The confirmed festival announcement places the project alongside OSZYLAYTER as part of the contemporary dark-electro and industrial side of the line-up, with an emphasis on forceful, club-oriented electronics. That makes Cyborg Projekt X something of the unknown variable of the evening, especially for listeners arriving primarily for the established EBM names. In a festival whose history has always mixed recognised acts with smaller projects, that is hardly out of character. KRIEG-B KRIEG-B is much newer as a project but comes with considerable history behind its members. The duo was formed in June 2023 by Dominique Lallement, known from Kriegbereit, Cobalt 60 and K-Bereit, and Benoît Buyse, associated with Dreadfool, Anamorphosis and Nihiliste. The project describes its music as a meeting point between industrial electronics, EBM and darkwave, drawing on several decades of electronic music rather than one specific period. Their debut album “War Drums’ Resonance” arrived in November 2024, with tracks including “S.C.S.N”, “Parabellum”, “Artificial Minds”, “Truth Lies” and “King of Emptiness”. In a sense, KRIEG-B makes a neat closing piece to the Elektrisch concept: a young project constructed by musicians carrying several earlier generations of European industrial electronics with them. More than the line-up The revived Elektrisch has also developed a strong physical-release component. The 18th edition was accompanied by exclusive 10-inch festival vinyl releases, while emmobiz has already announced a V.A. “19. Elektrisch Festival” 10-inch connected to this year’s event. The appeal of the 19th edition goes beyond Portion Control finally returning to Zwickau. The five acts represent very different positions within the same broad history: British industrial experimentation, Hungarian old-school EBM, contemporary German dark electronics, and a new Franco-Belgian project carrying the experience of earlier industrial formations into something current. That is probably the strongest reason to pay attention to Elektrisch. After a fourteen-year absence, the festival did not return simply to recreate the period in which it originally existed. Its current identity depends on putting that history into the same room with what came after it. 19. Elektrisch Festival: date, venue and line-up Elektrisch Festival 24 October 2026 Club Seilerstraße Seilerstraße 1B, 08056 Zwickau, Germany Line-up: Portion Control Escalator OSZYLAYTER Cyborg Projekt X KRIEG-B Doors: 19:00 Start: 20:00 Tickets are available through emmobiz Records.
items._cn_summary: 本文为德国茨维考第19届Elektrisch音乐节预告与历史回顾。音乐节自2000年代延续至今，经历14年沉寂后由emmobiz厂牌于2024年重启，2026年秋再次举办。阵容将Portion Control（1979年成立的英国工业电子先驱）等老牌团体与Escalator、KRIEG-B、Cyborg Projekt X等新晋及当代项目并置，体现电子音乐作为连续体而非断代史的策展思路。文章梳理了历届参与艺术家如Absolute Body Control、Test Dept、In Strict Confidence等工业/EBM代表人物，并提及Portion Control即将推出的Artoffact档案合辑。整体属于活动信息与历史综述性质，侧重策划脉络而非音乐分析，缺乏对具体声响或作品的技术评论。

items.body: Winter Sect will release “Graveyard Girl” on October 2, 2026 on Bandcamp and streaming platforms, a new single from the Washington, D.C. goth rock band’s upcoming EP, “Offering.” The track follows “Say Goodbye,” released earlier in 2026. The sound of ‘Graveyard Girl’ Where “Say Goodbye” leaned into darker territory, “Graveyard Girl” keeps its post-punk backbone but loosens up, pulling in funk bass lines, garage grit, indie pop hooks and a touch of bossa nova rhythm. Singer, lyricist and keyboardist Heather Wayward said the song came together almost by accident during a rehearsal setup: “The song pretty much started with Claudia grooving out on a bass line. It was catchy and I thought let’s do something completely different and not so serious and macabre. First the hook was discovered and we built from there. So with that funk of a groove my mind started walking. Where? Through the graveyard of course. It came together in a cool way and a little twist at the end just makes it fun.” About Winter Sect Winter Sect was formed in late 2023 by California native Claudia Neuman and guitarist Anthony Piazza, both members of DC/Baltimore post-punk band Sister Ex, to pursue a feedback-drenched sound spanning goth, new wave, industrial and psychedelic music with a dark, theatrical rock presentation. The lineup is rounded out by Heather Wayward on keys and vocals and drummer Darryl J. Dardenne, with Neuman also on bass and vocals. The band released two singles, “Mystic Twin” and “Haunted House,” in 2024, followed by “Say Goodbye” in 2026. “Graveyard Girl” will appear on the band’s upcoming EP, “Offering.”

items._cn_summary: 这是关于华盛顿特区后朋克/哥特摇滚乐队 Winter Sect 新单曲《Graveyard Girl》的发布介绍，将收录于即将发行的EP《Offering》中。与前作《Say Goodbye》偏向暗色调不同，这首新单曲在后朋克骨架上融入放克贝斯线、车库摇滚质感、独立流行钩子以及轻微的波萨诺瓦节奏，整体氛围更为轻松。歌曲创作源于排练时贝斯手 Claudia 的即兴律动，主唱兼词作者 Heather Wayward 据此发展出旋律与歌词，主题围绕墓地意象展开，但刻意回避沉重与恐怖的基调，结尾带有出人意料的小转折。乐队成立于2023年底，成员来自后朋克乐队 Sister Ex，风格横跨哥特、新浪潮、工业与迷幻音乐，以暗黑戏剧化的舞台呈现著称。该文为新闻稿性质的信息发布，缺乏深度音乐评论内容。

items.body: Manufracture Music release the single “System Apathy” on 20 October 2026, under a pre-order campaign already live on Bandcamp. The Vienna-based project, run by producer Valerian Steel, built the track entirely on analog synthesizers, drum machines and raw voltage, with no software instruments involved. System Apathy by Manufracture Music The Bandcamp description describes the release as continuing the project’s A.C.I. concept, short for Analog Core Industrial: “Manufracture Music operates on a strict hardware-first philosophy. […] Forged in Vienna, ‘System Apathy’ is built entirely on unforgiving analog synthesizers, drum machines, and raw voltage. The physical behavior of the machines – their limitations, imperfections, and textures – becomes the composition itself.” Steel described the approach directly to Side-Line as “a cold, relentless EBM transmission born from technological friction and dystopian sound design.” Manufracture Music’s second A.C.I. release “System Apathy” follows “The Scene Lies (A.C.I. Manifesto)“, the two-track statement Manufracture Music released on 14 August 2026 that introduced A.C.I. as a stated concept: hardware-only production positioned against generative AI tools in the electronic underground. Where that release took the form of a spoken-word manifesto, “System Apathy” returns the project to song form while keeping the same zero-software constraint. About Manufracture Music Manufracture Music is the industrial, EBM and darkwave project of producer Valerian Steel, based in Vienna, Austria. He also runs the dance-oriented Fourtyfication*5 and the ambient-leaning Music of Synergia under his own name, and has worked with a vocalist credited only as Enzo across several Manufracture Music tracks. The debut album “Fractured Empires” appeared in early 2025, followed by the “Mormon” EP on 29 March 2025 and a run of singles through 2025 and 2026, including “Isolated”, “Ghosts” featuring Enzo, “Blood Syntax”, “Hateration”, “Tearfall”, “End of Life”, “Null Rite System” featuring Enzo, “Kinetic Decay”, “Skip My Tracks” and “Synthetic Species”. “The Scene Lies (A.C.I. Manifesto)” introduced the A.C.I. concept on 14 August 2026, and “System Apathy” now becomes the second release built under that same hardware-only method, due 20 October 2026.
items._cn_summary: 维也纳制作人Valerian Steel以Manufracture Music之名推出单曲《System Apathy》，延续其A.C.I.（Analog Core Industrial）概念，整首作品完全由模拟合成器、鼓机和原始电压信号构建，刻意排除任何软件乐器与生成式AI工具的使用。这种硬件优先的制作理念将机器自身的局限、不完美与物理质感转化为作曲素材，呈现出冷酷、压迫感的EBM质感与反乌托邦声响设计。该作品是继八月发表的宣言式spoken-word作品之后的第二张A.C.I.系列发行，从宣言回归歌曲形式但保留零软件约束。Manufracture Music此前已发表专辑《Fractured Empires》及多首单曲，风格涵盖工业、EBM与暗潮领域，硬件至上的工艺立场在当前AI工具普及的地下电子圈中具有明确的概念对抗意味。

items.body: This Mortal Coil, the rotating collective of musicians and vocalists assembled by 4AD founder Ivo Watts-Russell, released its second studio album, “Filigree & Shadow,” on 22 September 1986 through 4AD. The double LP turns 40 this year. The album gathered 25 tracks, about half of them instrumental, credited to This Mortal Coil but built around a different set of contributors than the project’s 1984 debut. Ivo Watts-Russell and producer John Fryer recorded and mixed “Filigree & Shadow” at Blackwing and Palladium Studios, with arrangements from Simon Raymonde of Cocteau Twins, cellist Martin McCarrick and engineer John Turner, plus violin and viola from Gini Ball. Dead Can Dance percussionist Peter Ulrich and members of Dif Juz, The Wolfgang Press and Colourbox also appeared on the record. Vocalists including Dominic Appleton of Breathless and Alison Limerick sang cover interpretations of songs by Tim Buckley, Gene Clark, Van Morrison, Colin Newman and Talking Heads. “Filigree & Shadow” reached number 53 on the UK Albums Chart and number 2 on the UK Indie Chart, and it streams on Spotify. About This Mortal Coil Ivo Watts-Russell founded 4AD in London in 1980 and built This Mortal Coil a few years later to record music outside the constraints of a fixed band. In 1983 he brought together Cocteau Twins’ Elizabeth Fraser and Robin Guthrie, Cindytalk’s Gordon Sharp and members of Modern English to re-record two Modern English songs as the medley “Sixteen Days/Gathering Dust.” Its B-side, a cover of Tim Buckley’s “Song to the Siren” sung by Fraser and Guthrie alone, entered the UK Singles Chart at number 66 and led Watts-Russell to build a full album around the same idea. That album, “It’ll End in Tears,” followed in 1984 on 4AD. This Mortal Coil never had a fixed lineup. Watts-Russell and engineer John Fryer were its only constant members, and each record drew on a different group of musicians and singers, most pulled from 4AD’s own roster. “Filigree & Shadow” followed in 1986 as the project’s second album, again produced by Watts-Russell and Fryer, with Simon Raymonde, Martin McCarrick and Gini Ball forming its core backing group and Peter Ulrich among the guest musicians. This Mortal Coil closed its studio run with “Blood” in 1991, on which vocalist Caroline Crawley – whose death Side-Line reported in 2016 – was among the featured singers. After the group’s run ended, Watts-Russell continued the same collaborative approach under the name The Hope Blister from 1998, while Fryer went on to produce and engineer widely across the 4AD roster and beyond. “Filigree & Shadow” turns 40 this year, four decades into a project that treated an album as a collaboration rather than the work of a fixed band.
items._genre: darkwave / post-punk / ethereal / dream pop / gothic
items._cn_summary: 这是4AD厂牌旗下This Mortal Coil的第二张专辑《Filigree & Shadow》发行四十周年的回顾性文章。专辑由厂牌创始人Ivo Watts-Russell与制作人John Fryer在Blackwing和Palladium录音室完成，汇集了Cocteau Twins成员Simon Raymonde、大提琴手Martin McCarrick、小提琴手Gini Ball等多位乐手与客座打击乐手Peter Ulrich。25首曲目中约半数为器乐作品，人声部分由Breathless主唱Dominic Appleton和Alison Limerick等演绎，翻唱自Tim Buckley、Gene Clark、Van Morrison、Colin Newman和Talking Heads的作品。该项目以浮动阵容著称，每张唱片都邀请不同音乐人参与，将专辑视为一次集体协作而非固定乐队的产物。专辑当年在英国专辑榜达到第53位，在独立榜取得第2名。

items.body: Review by Mauro_2112 — Yes's only concept album and perhaps their most controversial one, Tales from Topographic Oceans is a very ambitious (some would say pretentious even) record that pretty much embodies all of the excess and extravagance of prog. That characteristic, however, sometimes is for its detriment. Throught its more than 80 minutes, the album can sometimes feel pretty tedious, featuring a lot of material that just doesn't compare to Yes's more widely agreed upon masterpieces, however every song is still generaly pretty good, especialy The Revealing Science of God which at least in my opinion is one Yes's best Epics. Overall, a really fun experience.
items._cn_summary: 这是Yes乐队唯一一张概念专辑，发行于1973年，以超过80分钟的篇幅呈现了前卫摇滚的雄心与铺张。全作分为四个长篇乐章，每章对应一张黑胶唱片的一面，结构宏大，乐手展开大量器乐即兴与变奏。Jon Anderson的歌词灵感源自印度教经典《薄伽梵歌》，探讨意识、宇宙与精神觉醒的主题。Rick Wakeman以哈蒙德风琴与Moog合成器层层堆叠，Steve Howe的吉他穿梭于民谣指弹与东方旋律之间。整体呈现出70年代交响化前卫摇滚的典型特征：冗长、华丽、追求史诗感，编曲密度高且段落繁多。《The Revealing Science of God》被乐评人认为是最具代表性的一章。然而专辑的篇幅与铺陈也使其成为Yes最具争议的作品，对偏好紧凑结构的听众而言容易显得冗赘拖沓。

items.body: Review by toroddreincarnated — The second album from this band from Norway.The band was a duo with a line-up of double bass, bass, guitars, keyboards, concertina, effects andvocals.A number of guests added drums, violins, strings and trumpet.This is the follow-up album to their 2024 debut album Bridge Of Sighs from 2024. An album I reviewedback in April 2024 in # 3 of my blog The Sound Of Fighting Cats. I gave it a three stars review.Lullabies for the Marooned clocks in at three quarters of an hour.The music here is art-rock.The band, I mean duo, has retreated from the more rocking soundscape on their debut album into amuch more intimate, softly spoken and refined soundscape on their new album, the follow-up album.Early Genesis, Procol Harum, Sylvan, Talk Talk and Peter Hammill are good references here. There areeven some Steve Hogarth era Marillion lurking around in their music too. There is a blend of acoustic and electric instruments here, including guitars. The strings is addinga lot of colours and are complementing the great vocals.This is an album where a piece of music crosses over to becoming an artwork. The result is a great album and one of this year's better albums from Norway, the new powerhouse inart-rock and prog rock. 4 stars
items._genre: art rock / progressive rock / crossover prog
items._cn_summary: 挪威二人乐队VIAMEDIA的第二张专辑，从首作更具摇滚张力的声响退回到更为内敛、柔和的艺术摇滚路线。乐评指出作品融入了原声与电声乐器，弦乐为整体增添色彩，人声表现力突出。参考对象涵盖早期Genesis、Procol Harum、Sylvan、Talk Talk以及Peter Hammill的创作风格，Steve Hogarth时期Marillion的影响亦隐现其中。整张专辑时长约四十五分钟，被乐评视为音乐向艺术作品跨越的一次尝试，在挪威近年艺术摇滚与前卫摇滚复兴浪潮中占据一席之地。配器上以低音提琴、贝斯、吉他、键盘、手风琴与效果器为核心，辅以客座乐手贡献的鼓、提琴与 trumpet，层次丰富而克制。

items.body: Review by alainPP — NORTH SEA ECHOES, nothing new except for extending their first offering: heavier, more melancholic, more pervasive."A Time of Innocence and Purpose," with its bass and hypnotic, unsettling electro sample, is featured on LUNATIC SOUL. A beautiful ascent with Ray taking the lead, where things become much more interesting. A kind of GILDENLOW and pugnacious OSI hybrid, thanks to that captivating voice that makes all the difference. The ambient, intimate atmosphere makes you close your eyes and dream along to the edgy riff. "Enjoy The View" delves deeper into the electro-synthetic sound with its two-tone vocals and addictive instrumentation. The industrial riff, a sound effect on the thunderous breakdown, the keyboard undulating in a new dark-wave style. The magic works and endures with the energy of the invigorating chorus over the haunting verse, the haunting, dark outro. "Good Enough" features a crystalline, airy, stereo acoustic arpeggio reminiscent of the good old days. The raw, spoken-word vocals are laid over it, creating a country evening feel. The warm crescendo, with Ray as the sonic hero, evokes a dark Louisiana vibe with animals singing in the background: sublime and utterly simple, surfing on the atmospheric. "I'll Leave A Light On" kicks off with a fat riff, a melancholic nod to Katatonia. The pre-screamed vocals over the powerful sound, the chorus like something out of the mainstream era: the nostalgia is amplified by a punchy guitar solo bursting with notes. An added choir graces this track, which flows effortlessly, nothing new but well executed, finally on Fates Warning. "All Fall Away" boasts a bouncy bass beat. A dark, monolithic feel, redolent of Eurythmics in a heavy version, for this primal alternative drift. The guitar twists and turns, illuminating the space, the beat becomes oppressive, reminiscent of PARADISE LOST with Ray's voice, the chorus, then the beat abruptly stopping."Revenge," with its Wavy-esque guitar, surfs on the scales of THE CURE. This decadent rock descends to the realm of electro-pop, a softer DEPECHE MODE, Ray bribing his vocal cords. A repetitive, melancholic finale, far removed from prog rock. "Villains Or Saints" returns to mainstream, mainstream rock with its heavy melody, surfing once again on FATES WARNING. The haunting, synthetic rhythm builds and creates a heavy guitar space over the velvety keyboard. Ray conducts this masterful string piece, always effortless yet captivating, this timeless ballad. "What Is And What Was What," with its dark, ambient, mysterious intro and that wind that seems to come from nowhere. Vocals over a guitar arpeggio, choir over organ, hairs shiver. The bass resonates, clears the speakers, the pleasure of having this vibrant, body-piercing sound, like an arrow piercing your heart. "All That Comes After" returns to edgy rock, energized by its catchy melody. A B-side track that doesn't offer anything new, however, except perhaps to test the stereo image on the atmospheric drift. This melodic sound takes you back to the previous millennium. "How To Cast A Shadow" concludes, the new-wave vibe with its heady keyboard, as fat as the 'metroganic' drums, Ray weaving through this dark, hybrid, alternative slow jam. The mantra-like latency for dancing, swaying with his wife, the guitar both melancholic and slide-like. The feeling of navigating a bayou. A heavy guitar solo, the sound that makes you headbang, the refrain of 80s hard rock bands, I'm sucked into this musical spiral. The finale features Ray clinging to the primal synth, shh... Silence remains a constant presence throughout the album, with its enveloping notes.NORTH SEA ECHOES pushes their identity further with a heavy, dark approach, evolving with the addition of electronic elements to delve into the ghosts of the past, temptation, and reflection. (3.75)
items._genre: crossover prog / darkwave / industrial / alternative rock
items._cn_summary: NORTH SEA ECHOES的第二张专辑延续并拓展了首作的路线，整体氛围更沉重、更阴郁、更加弥漫。乐队以人声为绝对主导——Ray的嗓音被乐评形容为兼具Gildenlow的沉稳与OSI的锋利，在暗潮式的冷感与旋律性之间游走。制作上明显偏向电子合成元素：合成器音色以dark-wave方式波动，配合工业感吉他riff，形成一种阴冷的电气化肌理。多首作品在结构上借鉴了Katatonia、Paradise Lost、Depeche Mode等暗潮/哥特金属名团的语汇，合成器流行段落与重型段落交替出现。主唱Ray的演绎被反复称赞为自然而有感染力，但乐评也指出专辑整体并未带来太多新意，更像是在既有框架内的精致延伸。

items.body: Black Tape For A Blue Girl and Projekt Records reissue “The Rope” on October 2, presenting the 1986 debut album in a limited edition that pairs the original mix, remastered, with a new 2026 mix by Sam Rosenthal for its 40th anniversary. The 2LP edition is limited to 300 copies on 140-gram vinyl, with LP1 pressed on baby blue vinyl with black splatters and LP2 on transparent blue vinyl with white splatters. A 2CD digipak edition adds seven bonus tracks. Both formats are released via Projekt Records. “The Rope” is Black Tape For A Blue Girl’s debut album, the project Sam Rosenthal built around his songwriting and electronics, with Oscar Herrera on vocals. Each format includes the full 12-track album twice: the original 1986 mix, remastered, and the new 2026 mix. Martin Bowes of Attrition handled the mastering. The 2LP package adds a 16-page lyric and memorabilia fanzine insert plus a sticker; the 2CD edition comes in a 6-panel digipak with a 4-panel photo insert and sticker. The original 1986 tracklist runs: “memory, uncaring friend”, “hide in yourself”, “within these walls”, “the holy terrors”, “end”, “seven days til sunrise”, “the rope”, “the few remaining threads”, “the lingering flicker”, “slow blur”, “the floor was hard but home” and “we return”. The 2CD edition adds seven bonus tracks exclusive to that format: “the lingering flicker (first draft)”, “within these walls (early mix with clarinet)”, “the holy terrors (long)”, “second dream”, “the lingering flicker (isolated violins)”, “within these walls (short with violins)” and “memory, uncaring friend (remix intro)”. Sam Rosenthal on writing ‘The Rope’ Black Tape For A Blue Girl’s Rosenthal, who also founded Projekt Records, described the circumstances that produced the album: “In November ’85, following two years of recording instrumental electronic music, I invited Oscar Herrera to sing two songs on my ISLANDS cassette. A few months later in February of ’86 I left Florida for college in Orange, California. I was 20 years old, feeling isolated, lonely, missing friends back home. In my dorm room that spring I used the school’s Fostex 250 4-track cassette portastudio to record songs with my lyrics and melodies. Writing words for Oscar to sing over my ethereal and ambient music helped me explore those angsty and tangled feelings. The Rope is half vocal and half instrumental. It’s all quite minimal, yet it’s an album listeners still mention as a favorite. Capturing the confusion and darkness I felt at that time remains valid; new listeners connect with it today. I never would have expected that 40 years later The Rope would be listened to and appreciated by new generations. It’s really nice knowing those feelings are timeless, and the music has a place in people’s lives.” Uncut included “The Rope” in its “200 Greatest Goth Albums” feature, describing it as: “The vehicle for the more electronic songwriting of Projekt Records’ founder Sam Rosenthal, brought to life by singer Oscar Herrera’s arch delivery. BTFABG spun a unique thread of ambient darkwave, neoclassical exoticism and dark cabaret on their relatively bare-boned and lo-fi debut album.” The Rope (40th) by Black Tape For A Blue Girl About Black Tape For A Blue Girl Black Tape For A Blue Girl is the project Sam Rosenthal formed in 1986, built around his own songwriting and electronics and centered from the start on the pairing of his instrumental, ambient compositions with vocalists singing his lyrics. “The Rope”, released that year on Projekt Records, the label Rosenthal founded, introduced Oscar Herrera as vocalist alongside contributions from Allan Kraut, Kim Prior, Adam Buhler, Candy Sherlock and Lara Radford. The project’s discography continued through “Mesmerized by the Sirens” (1987), “Ashes in the Brittle Air” (1989), “A Chaos of Desire” (1991), “This Lush Garden Within” (1993), “Remnants of a Deeper Purity” (1996), “As One Aflame Laid Bare by Desire” (1999), “The Scavenger Bride” (2002), “Halo Star” (2004), “10 Neurotics” (2009), “Tenderotics” (2013), “These Fleeting Moments” (2016), “To Touch the Milky Way” (2018) and “The Cleft Serpent” (2021). Projekt has revisited several of these titles as anniversary reissues in recent years, including “The Cleft Serpent” and “Ashes in the Brittle Air” on vinyl, “Mesmerized by the Sirens” on vinyl and double CD, and “As One Aflame Laid Bare by Desire” and “Remnants of a Deeper Purity” in their own anniversary editions. Rosenthal has also continued to release music outside the project, including ambient and drone recordings under his own name. The 40th anniversary edition of “The Rope” extends that reissue campaign to the album that started it, presenting Herrera’s original vocal performances and Rosenthal’s 1986 arrangements alongside his 2026 revisiting of the same material.
items._cn_summary: 这篇文章报道了黑胶与CD厂牌为纪念乐队首张专辑发行四十周年而推出的再版版本，详细介绍了两个版本的规格：2LP限量300张，分别采用浅蓝带黑点和透明蓝带白点压片工艺，附赠16页歌词纪念册；2CD版本则增加七首独家附赠曲目，包含早期混音和孤立的提琴声轨。新版本包含原版1986年混音的母带重制版与Sam Rosenthal制作的全新2026年混音，Attrition乐队的Martin Bowes负责母带处理。Sam Rosenthal本人在文章中回顾了专辑创作背景：1986年从佛罗里达前往加州读大学后，在宿舍用四轨卡带录音机创作了这张半人声半器乐的极简作品，融合了氛围电子与人声表达，捕捉了当时年少孤独的复杂情感。文章以新闻报道形式呈现再版信息，缺少对音乐本身的深度分析和乐评内容。

items.body: Jah Wobble & The Invaders Of The Heart reissue the 2xCD collection “The Usual Suspects” on Dimple Discs on November 13, 2026. Originally released in 2017, the 23-track set has been unavailable for years and now changes hands at collectors’ prices; the digital edition is already available on Bandcamp, with the physical 2xCD prepared for that November date to coincide with a UK and Belgium tour. Usual Suspects by Jah Wobble & The Invaders Of The Heart “The Usual Suspects” gathers new recordings of Wobble’s solo material alongside songs from Invaders Of The Heart and his former band Public Image Ltd (PiL), drawn from a catalogue spanning almost forty years at the time of recording. The album was recorded at The Smokehouse studios in East London and opens with a version of PiL’s debut single “Public Image”, reworked from the band’s 1978 debut album. The tracklist also folds in cover versions of two film themes, “Midnight Cowboy” and “Get Carter”, plus Dawn Penn’s “You Don’t Love Me (No, No, No)” featuring vocalist Aurora Dawn, and a new take on “Visions Of You”, which originally featured Sinéad O’Connor on Invaders Of The Heart’s Mercury Prize-nominated 1992 album “Rising Above Bedlam”. The set closes with live recordings of “Liquidator” and “Poptones”, the latter drawn from PiL’s “Metal Box”. Recording personnel on “The Usual Suspects” comprised Jah Wobble on bass, vocals and percussion, Marc Layton-Bennett on drums, percussion and backing vocals, Martin Chung on guitars, George King on keyboards and backing vocals, Steve Rigby on programming and backing vocals, Sean Corby on trumpet and flugelhorn, Aurora Dawn on vocals, and Holly Macve on vocals. Of the band behind the album, Wobble said: “This band has been a delight to play with. Similar to my first early ’80s version of the Invaders, they can all really play, plus all genre bases […] are covered. It’s a big deal to me, because it’s like a 35 year old dream has finally been realised. This is how I heard The Invaders of the Heart sound all those years ago. A classy fusion of genres. Groovy, dubby but always changing and developing. Never standing still.” Tour dates for Jah Wobble & The Invaders Of The Heart The reissue follows a UK tour and comes ahead of Belgian dates in November. Confirmed shows: October 3 – Stourbridge, Katie Fitzgerald’s (UK) October 16 – Todmorden, Unitarian Church (UK) October 21 – Frome, The Tunnels (UK) October 22 – Bristol, The Fleece (UK) October 23 – Reading, Face Bar (UK) November 7 – London, Bush Hall (UK) November 25 – Hasselt, Club AFF (Belgium) November 26 – Bruges, Cactus Muziekcentrum (Belgium) November 27 – Oudenaarde, Harmonie Oudenaarde (Belgium) Tickets are available via Songkick. About Jah Wobble & The Invaders Of The Heart Jah Wobble, born John Wardle, is a bass guitarist and vocalist from East London who was the original bassist in Public Image Ltd alongside John Lydon from the band’s 1978 formation, co-writing and playing on the 1979 album “Metal Box” before leaving in late 1980. He formed Jah Wobble’s Invaders Of The Heart in 1982; that same period brought studio work alongside Can’s Holger Czukay and Jaki Liebezeit, U2 guitarist The Edge, and producer François Kevorkian. Invaders Of The Heart’s commercial peak came with 1991’s “Rising Above Bedlam”, nominated for the Mercury Prize, which included the UK top-40 single “Visions Of You” featuring Sinéad O’Connor. Wobble has since worked with artists including Ginger Baker, Björk, Brian Eno, Baaba Maal, Massive Attack, Sinéad O’Connor, Pharoah Sanders and his wife Zi Lan Liao on guzheng and harp. He reunited with former PiL guitarist Keith Levene in 2012 for the “Metal Box in Dub” shows and the album “Yin & Yang”. Jah Wobble & The Invaders Of The Heart recorded “The Usual Suspects” at The Smokehouse studios in East London, releasing it in 2017 following a six-month UK tour, as covered by Side-Line at the time. More recently, Wobble released the albums “Dub, Vol 1” (2025) and “Automated Paradise” (2026, with former Siouxsie & The Banshees guitarist Jon Klein) on Dimple Discs, and “Mystic Liverpool: The Beatles Psychedelic Songbook” with his sons, who record as Tian Qiyi, released by Cherry Red in August 2026. His autobiography, “Memoirs of a Geezer: Music, Life, Mayhem”, was published by Serpent’s Tail in 2009 and reissued in expanded form as “Dark Luminosity” by Faber & Faber in 2024. Dimple Discs now reissues “The Usual Suspects” as a 2xCD on November 13, 2026, timed to Jah Wobble & The Invaders Of The Heart’s UK and Belgium tour dates.
items._cn_summary: 文章报道了Jah Wobble与The Invaders Of The Heart乐队2xCD合辑《The Usual Suspects》的再版消息。原版发行于2017年，由东伦敦Smokehouse录音室录制完成，收录23首曲目，汇集了Wobble个人作品、Invaders Of The Heart乐队作品以及前Public Image Ltd时期作品的重新演绎。曲目涵盖PiL 1978年首张专辑中的《Public Image》重制版、两首电影主题曲翻唱（《午夜牛郎》与《盖特·卡特》）、Dawn Penn雷鬼经典的合作版本，以及与Sinéad O'Connor合作的《Visions Of You》新版。专辑以PiL《Metal Box》中的《Poptones》现场录音收尾。Wobble本人将这支乐队描述为跨越多种风格的融合，兼具dub律动与持续演变的气质。再版将于2026年11月发行，配合英国与比利时的巡演日程。整体内容偏向新闻通稿性质，缺乏深度音乐分析。

items.body: Room of Wires, the UK industrial/electronic duo of two producers who both go by Andrew, released the single “Skin weevil” on September 18, 2026, self-released on Bandcamp. The two-track release pairs the title track with “Do not leave a message” and arrives while the duo works on a new album. Skin weevil by Room of Wires Room of Wires bring an industrial and electronic sound that mixes hard-hitting rhythm programming with the duo’s usual dark ambient textures and field recordings. Both tracks on “Skin weevil” were written and produced by Room of Wires; the cover artwork is by the duo as well, with performance for camera by Fenia Kotsopoulou and photography by Daz Disley. Room of Wires’ ‘Skin weevil’ single The duo has not met in person: one member works with hardware and a tangle of physical wires, the other in software and virtual cables, sharing ideas and sounds over the internet. That process has produced “Skin weevil” as a standalone two-track single rather than part of a longer EP or album, released independently while the pair continue work on their next full-length. No further tracks or release date for that album have been announced. About Room of Wires Room of Wires is a UK industrial/electronic duo of two producers, both named Andrew, who write and record without ever having met, exchanging sounds and ideas remotely. Their debut EP, “Asylum sneaker”, appeared on Section27 in August 2014, followed by the Bandcamp-only “Dead skins” EP in November 2015, “Used as a runner” on Section27 in June 2016, “Black medicine” on Section27 in June 2017, and the remix-featuring “Mastakink” EP, self-released in October 2017. Their debut album, “White transit”, followed in November 2018, and the mini-LP “Test subject” arrived in October 2019. Room of Wires signed to the German label ant-zen for the albums “Plague of people” (April 2021) and “Welcome to the end game” (February 2023), releasing the “Fever switch” EP on Rednetic in October 2021 in between. Further self-released EPs followed with “Floodplains” (November 2023) and the album “If no other means are effective” in December 2025, the duo’s first full-length in close to three years. Alongside their own catalogue, Room of Wires record collaborative material as DasF and Cave like carving, and have contributed remixes and tracks to releases by Ah Cama-Sotz, Flint Glass, 4T Thieves and other acts. “Skin weevil” is their first new material since 2025’s “If no other means are effective”, released as the pair continue work on a new Room of Wires album.
items._cn_summary: 英国二人组合 Room of Wires 由两位同名 Andrew 的制作人组成，他们从未见面，分别通过硬件与软件远程协作完成创作。这种独特的远程工作方式贯穿于所有作品的形成中。"Skin Weevil" 双轨单曲于 2026 年 9 月独立发行，标题曲搭配 "Do not leave a message"。音乐风格融合了硬朗的节奏编程、深沉的氛围音色层与田野录音，展现工业电子的冷峻质感。封面设计与制作均由二人独立完成，包括摄影与视觉呈现。Room of Wires 此前曾在德国厂牌 ant-zen 发行专辑，并长期在 Section27、Rednetic 等小厂牌之间穿梭。这张单曲是该组合继 2025 年专辑后的首支新作，预示着新专辑正在制作中，但尚未公布更多曲目细节或发行日期。

items.body: Karine Polwart has proved herself to be an exceptional talent as a singer and songwriter for many years, all the way back to her time with Malinky (the song �Thaney� was a revelation). As a solo artist she�s grown and continually expanded her horizons, coming now to Windblown , a project that began life seven years ago, when Polwart, along with sound designer and composer Pippa Murphy, was artist in residence at Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. The album, with its stage show and book, tells the story of the garden�s oldest specimen, a Sabal palm tree ( Sabal bermudana ), which was gently felled in 2021, and contained a surprise nobody had expected. The tree is the starting point. From there, imagination runs free. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan It�s an album of voice and piano (the outstanding, sympathetic Dave Milligan), and, for all its global outlook on connections, one that�s very rooted in Scotland. You can hear it on the opening track, �Hear The Rigging/Last In Line,� where the melody becomes a slow, aching lament that would sound completely natural on the pipes. The stripped-down sound gives the songs both crafted stateliness and real intimacy. Each one is an exhalation, a memory, a celebration and exploration, with recurring phrases in the words and music acting as touchstones � or even hooks; they certainly stick in the mind. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan In many ways, this is a modest album, with piano, voice and light, judicious soundscaping. It won�t overpower with noise. Yet at the same time, it�s epic, a look at history, at the flow and grandeur of nature, and the things we all carry within us. The music, and especially Polwart�s warm, compassionate voice, envelop the listener, and makes them a participant, not an observer, but a part of the journey and the history. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan The irony arrives at the end, when the venerable old tree is down, and seeds are examined. What people for two hundred years had believed to be a Sabal bermudana turns out to be something different, a Sabal mexicana � and one of the small plants fill grow where it�s forerunner once stood. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan Like music, plants keep to a different time � and this album/book/show give the tree the requiem it deserves, as well as hope for the future. Find the artist online. Sara Serpa - Encounters and Collisions (Review) Karine Polwart- Laws of Motion (Review) Live in the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, 2025

items.body: Sudan Dudan is a Norwegian duo, Marit Karlberg and Anders Erik R�ine, who have released four albums over the last twenty years. On M�rke refrenger , their fifth, they are joined by Hans Hulb�kmo and Magnus Skavhaug Nergaard, contributing instrumentally and with the production. There are eight songs on the album with accompaniment principally led by acoustic guitar, augmented by fiddles, langeleik, lyre, jaws harp and more. The opening track, �Gard og grind� (�Fence and gate�) is a fine introduction to what is to come: finger-picked acoustic guitar, fiddle, bass and snare-drum played with brushes leading into the harmonized vocal, together creating an alluring sound drawing the listener in. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The mood of the album, reflected in its title which translates as �Dark Refrains,� is not always dark, but most of the material, including the title track, certainly has a reflective quality. According to the press release �the lyrics smoulder with unease about the present and the future, while looking back to the myths and riddles of the past. They speak of the earth, the sun, the moon, stars and planets, of lost brothers, quarrelling sisters, loss and grief, of the power of imagination, and of the answers to the simplest and most difficult riddles.� The lyrics of all the songs, in Norwegian, are included in the sleeve notes and while a hasty online translation can aid with some understanding, the full meanings tend to remain cryptic, but there is a sense that words and music complement each other. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan For all its dark moodiness, M�rke refrenger does have its lighter moments. �Bagatelle� recalls and reinvents the melody of a well-known French song, adding some off-kilter harmonies, while �Rulleball� is more characteristically Norwegian, employing a vocal style known as tralling in which words are replaced by a vocalization of the melody, originally used to accompany dances when no instrument was available. No translation necessary there. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The final track �Skriften p� veggen� (�the writing on the wall�) features, for the only time on the album, electric guitar. The sound is deep and twangy, shades of Duane Eddy or a David Lynch soundtrack and it works very well. All in all a fine, imaginatively conceived and beautifully produced record, available as a download or vinyl. Find the artists online. Tako Toki - Un Dimanche � Monaco (Review) GuldGanger - GuldGanger (Review)

items.body:
The musical partnership between Kalaniemi and Alakotila has thrived over a remarkable 35 years, long enough to the Finnish pair to develop a stunning intimacy and telepathy. Kalaniemi is a lovingly melodic accordion player, with a sharp ear for a good tune, building each one into a thing of great beauty, while pianist Alakotila not only supports her but adds enough of his own to help transform every piece into a glistening gem.
There�s a sense of calmness to the work here, a long, sweet exhalation between two instrumentalists who are deep enough in sync to allow seamless improvisation beyond any written score and carry the listeners along with them. For much of the album, it�s just the pair of them, including Kalaniemi�s wordless voice, as on the opener, the tradional �Lyck�nskan.� She does charmingly sing lyrics on the title track, written by Lasse M�rtenson, with the sound there neatly and sparingly expanded with the addition of a string quartet.
Morgondimma
There are several original pieces alongside the tradition, with Kalaniemi�s �Hambo Vid F�bodan� a real standout, and it�s perhaps inevitable on any disc featuring accordion that a Piazzolla tune should be included, brings its own shadows to the whole (�Oblivion�). And, this being Finland, a tango is almost obligatory, in this case Alakotila�s �Tango Berlin.�
Tango Berlin
There�s a gentle, dreamlike quality to so much of this, flowing and mellifluous. The pieces aren�t an arena for showy virtuosity. Instead, the two musicians serve the tune, exploring and genuinely enjoying their performances.
It won�t shake the earth, but it makes for some true listening beauty.

items.body: Norwegian synthpop act Echo Image is entering the final phase of work on its new album, “My Shadow, My Echo and Me.” Pål-Magnus Rybom, the musician behind the project, has now listened to the record from beginning to end for the first time, describing the experience as “strange but pretty damn good.” The record has been in the making for close to 20 years, with only final mixing, mastering and the artwork still to complete. No release date has been announced yet. The album follows Echo Image’s return with the singles “Walk My Mind” (2021), “Mono No Aware” (2022), “Of Truth” (2023) and “Madsong” (2024), material that gradually marked the project’s way back after a long period of relative silence following its 2002 split. Rybom has linked each word in the title to a stage of his own story: the Shadow for what still weighs on him, the Echo for the music that got him through it, and Me for who he is now on the other side of it. The project involves several names from the Norwegian electronic scene. Apoptygma Berzerk‘s Stephan Groth, whose Pitch Black Drive label has released Echo Image’s comeback singles, has contributed creative input to the album, Einar Kristiansen Five is handling the mixes, and Linda Eikemo, who also sang on “Madsong,” contributes backing vocals. About Echo Image Echo Image is a Norwegian synthpop band from Fredrikstad, built around Pål-Magnus Rybom. Rybom and Jon-Ivar Berg began experimenting with electronic music in the summer of 1997 and recorded a demo; after Berg left to focus on his own project, Fredrik Hansen and Trine Bilet joined and the band took shape. Echo Image recorded the “Walkout” EP in December 1998 for the local label Kvarts Musikk, then signed to the US synthpop label A Different Drum in 2000, with the German label Bloodline handling European releases; Lars Kristian Holt joined as live guitarist around the same time. The single “Need to Be Proud” was mixed by Apoptygma Berzerk’s Stephan Groth, and the album “Compuphonic” followed in 2001, reaching number 28 on the CMJ RPM chart in the United States. After signing to Hard:Drive for the “Endless Day” single in 2002, Echo Image joined Apoptygma Berzerk on the European “Harmonizer” tour before splitting up later that year. The band reunited in 2016 for the vinyl-only compilation “Compulation” on HolmByKarlsen Rekords, gathering songs from Echo Image’s four earlier releases along with one previously unreleased track. In 2020, Echo Image signed to Pitch Black Drive, the label run by Apoptygma Berzerk’s Stephan Groth, and re-released its back catalogue digitally. The comeback single “Walk My Mind” arrived in March 2021, followed by “Mono No Aware” in 2022 and “Of Truth” in 2023. Rybom, now joined by Linda Eikemo, released the single “Madsong” in February 2024, co-produced by Groth and mixed by Einar Kristiansen Five. In 2025, Rybom lent vocals to German act Elektrostaub’s “Falling” EP on Alfa Matrix. Echo Image’s own next release, the album “My Shadow, My Echo and Me,” is now entering its last stretch after nearly two decades in the making.
items._cn_summary: 挪威合成器流行项目 Echo Image 由 Pål-Magnus Rybom 主导，历经约二十年完成新专辑《My Shadow, My Echo and Me》的录制，目前进入混音、母带与封面设计的收尾阶段。专辑标题三词分别对应创作者个人经历的不同阶段：阴影代表仍未释怀的过往，回响象征支撑他走过低谷的音乐，而自我则是当下的状态。Apoptygma Berzerk 的 Stephan Groth 在创意层面参与，Einar Kristiansen Five 负责混音，Linda Eikemo 提供和声。自 2002 年解散后，项目经 2021 至 2024 年陆续发行的数首单曲逐步回归。作为北欧电子场景中的独立制作，与暗潮及合成器流行圈子存在关联，但整体仍属类型框架内的常规操作，缺乏显著的实验性突破或跨领域融合。原文以新闻报道形式呈现专辑进度与乐队历史，未涉及音乐本身的深度评析。

items.body: Review by Finnforest — A Charming Entrance Salis was a band from Sardinia named for the two Salis brothers, Antonio and Francesco. They wouldrelease three albums in the 1970s and be yet another inhabitant of that deep RPI back bench. Farbeyond the many well-known classic Italian pop/rock bands getting respect and attention on thesurface, there were so many other bands who never made the front bench. Even many prog fans whoembrace the existence of RPI may not have heard of a band like Salis. And yet, so many of theseobscure groups have work that is worthy of attention even if it is not the full-blown progressiverock that would follow later in the decade.While most people will point to their "proggiest" third album, it is the this debut that is of mostinterest to me. It joins a crucial group of Italian proto-RPI bands who set the stage for what wascoming just around the bend. This group of bands ranges from Italian pop to blues rock to psychrock, all pushing the barriers of their own zone while releasing work that was not quite fullyformed progressive rock. Some are just okay and some are quite exciting. This is one of the betterones in my view. While you have the short song format and bluesy-jazzy psych rock variations, theirsecret weapon is their passion and an amazing feel for memorable little motifs that are not alwayspredictable. They begin to seep into your head after just a couple spins, and I think it may besttheir other two releases that get most of the attention. This first Salis album is a must for RPIfans who like stuff like Fabio Celi, Il Mucchio, and Equipe 84. Sometimes the special sauce is justyouth.
items._cn_summary: 这是撒丁岛乐队Salis的首张专辑，被定位为意大利前卫摇滚（RPI）的早期原型作品，介于流行、布鲁斯摇滚和迷幻摇滚之间。乐评指出，乐队运用短小歌曲结构、布鲁斯爵士式迷幻变奏，核心特点是充满激情的演绎和对易记动机短句的敏锐捕捉，旋律虽不复杂却颇具吸引力。整张专辑被视为七十年代成熟前卫摇滚来临前的过渡阶段产物，与同期意大利乐队Fabio Celi、Il Mucchio及Equipe 84的音乐风格相近。对于关注实验前卫、爵士即兴或电子融合的听众而言，这张专辑偏向传统摇滚框架内的旋律写作，跨界融合度有限，文化特色主要来自意大利七十年代摇滚场景，而非更具实验性的方向。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — Once again fabulously illustrated by Annette Appleton in a captivating pictorial style?part na�ve, part naturalistic, and slightly dreamlike?*Estanyo Nord* is the last album by the English duo The Light Afternoon, aka Steve Newland, the ultra-perfectionist multi-instrumentalist, and Annette Appleton, the singer-illustrator with a shy, fairy-like voice. To illustrate the cover of *Estanyo Nord* and the inside poster, Annette was determined to depict the Panorama house and its surroundings as a veritable Garden of Eden, with a profusion of very real animals?mostly birds and cats, but also dogs and a gecko?in a visionary and imaginative style that makes this miraculous bestiary seem surreal and symbolic.The album tells the story of this exotic miniature Walden, a little lost paradise, just a stone's throw from the road and a short walk from the sea, and of its inhabitants? whether human (Ana Cirema and all the other souls of the household) or non-human?mostly cats ("Our Time In The Tin North")?who thrived in Panorama under a dark velvet sky streaked with shooting stars. Conceptually and structurally, *Estanyo Nord* is divided into two distinct parts ("Part One: Anacirema," "Part Two: Estanyo Nord"), like the two sides of a vinyl record, each consisting of four tracks, 4 or 5 minutes per track, for a total running time of 38 minutes?thus respecting the spirit and constraints of vinyl records from their heyday. All of this is significant because *Estanyo Nord* draws heavily on the past?from nostalgic memories of Steve and Annette's personal histories to the musical past of everyone who lived through the '80s to the fullest, in a way that was deceptively carefree yet truly full of hope, filled with both certainties and doubts. " "I don't know what makes me happy, I just know what makes me sad, I do my best to remember all the things that make me glad" ("All Of These Things," luminous memories of Malta, France, and Spain) "Musically, Estanyo Nord is very different from our previous album because Steve didn't want to make *The History of Mr. Puffin Man?The Sequel*" (dixit Annette). One couldn't put it better. As dynamic and assertive as the previous album was languid, gentle, and undulating, *Estanyo Nord* has categorically moved away from the dark symphonic prog of La Renaissance or Dead Can Dance, with the instrumental sounds and rhythmic programming here very clearly oriented toward synth-pop. But both albums share the same melancholy and a highly cinematic approach to music, with subtle touches of modulation and tense minor chords. This is particularly evident from the very start of "Wide Open Highway Road Movie," with its *Midnight Express*-like atmosphere, its sharp guitar chords and solos set against highway rhythms, and its synths so distinctly '80s that you can almost hear that faint vintage hiss that followed each synth note, following the strange hum of the electric current that had set them vibrating. With a slower sequenced tempo, "The Girl from Panorama" is more reminiscent of Kraftwerk or the early Human League. Meanwhile, the more high-energy "Anacirema" and "Estanyo Nord"?true hit potential?blend new wave rock and dance music much as New Order did a few years ago. Those who enjoyed the symphonic harmonies of *The History Of Mr Puffin Man* might prefer "The Paradero" and "All of These Things," with their delicate, haunting melodies, piano arpeggios, mysterious or commanding synths, subtle vocal arrangements, and that guitar that reminds me of Pulsar's *Gorlitz* (1989) in a slightly decadent, fin-de-si�cle (20th-century) atmosphere that evokes Bowie's legendary and unconventional *Low*. This European atmosphere is present with even more tenderness and romanticism on the slow "Watching the Perseids," a small, classically influenced pocket symphony. "Our Time in the Tin North" is closer to the atmospheric post-prog of Soup or North Atlantic Oscillation or the dreamy electronica of Tangerine Dream's latest albums, which should appeal to most of us. But regardless of our musical preferences and how open-minded we are in this regard, it would be a shame to miss this precious opportunity to own such an artistic work?one that is as valuable for its visual presentation as for its musical content. At first glance, it may seem relatively far removed from the usual canons of progressive rock, but ultimately, it is as universal as beauty itself.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由英国二人组The Light Afternoon创作，概念上以Panorama之家为微型伊甸园的意象展开，将个人记忆与八十年代音乐情怀编织成双面唱片结构的作品。音乐上明显脱离前作暗色交响前卫摇滚的路线，转向合成器流行方向，以尖锐吉他与'80年代合成器质感构建公路电影般的氛围，保留半音阶与紧张小调和弦带来的忧郁底色，并延续高度电影化的叙事手法。 Annette Appleton的绘画为专辑赋予梦境般的视觉叙事，与音乐形成跨媒介的整体艺术表达。然而整体风格偏向怀旧复古合成器流行，与用户关注的实验、前卫、电子先锋等口味差距明显，创新性有限。

items.body: Zadisphere, an independent dark ritual techno project, published the video “Cathedral” on its official YouTube channel on September 9, 2026. Zadisphere makes a sound that mixes dark ritual techno with cinematic electronics and hypnotic rhythms, combining gothic and baroque elements, pipe organs, strings and choirs with analog sequences. “Cathedral” is a standalone video release; no tied single, EP or label has been confirmed. Zadisphere’s ‘Cathedral’ follows a steady run of new tracks “Cathedral” arrived in a run of near-weekly uploads from the project through August and September 2026, including “Czas / Time” on August 12, “Monolith Threshold” on September 1, “Ritual” on September 3, a remix of Ludwik Sempoliński’s “Ten wąsik” on September 11, “Nienazwane / Unnamed” on September 14 and “Po drugiej stronie / The other side” on September 16. No tracklist, formats or streaming availability have been confirmed for “Cathedral” beyond the YouTube upload. About Zadisphere Behind Zadisphere is a solo artist who treats mood and atmosphere as the project’s real subject, with sound built to serve that focus rather than the other way around. Its stated direction combines dark ritual techno, cinematic electronics and hypnotic rhythms with gothic and baroque influences, using pipe organs, strings, choirs and analog sequences. The project’s YouTube channel was created in January 2024, but its run of released tracks and videos began in August 2026 with “Czas / Time”, followed within weeks by “Monolith Threshold”, “Ritual” and “Cathedral”. Zadisphere has no confirmed label, Discogs entry or Wikipedia page. The project is also present on Instagram and maintains an official website. “Cathedral” is its latest video release.

items.body: Old Europa Cafe releases four new albums and three reissues on 23 October 2026, all as limited digipak CDs. The Italian power electronics, noise and dark ambient label, founded in Pordenone in 1983 by Rodolfo Protti, groups the batch around three reissues from the catalogue of Atrax Morgue, two new records tied to Swedish musician Nordvargr, and new albums from Black Leather Jesus and The Rita’s back catalogue. Atrax Morgue’s ‘Alive and Dead’, ‘Paranoia’ and ‘Pathophysiology’ reissued Atrax Morgue was the project of Marco Corbelli, an Italian noise musician born in Sassuolo in 1970 who died in 2007. Working mostly with a Sequential Circuits Six-Trak synthesizer, Corbelli built his early catalogue on cassette through the industrial and noise “cassette culture” of the early 1990s, releasing on his own Slaughter Productions before moving to labels including Old Europa Cafe, Relapse and RRRecords through the late 1990s. Old Europa Cafe reissues three Atrax Morgue titles on 23 October. ‘Alive and Dead’ is a CD re-edition of a cassette the label sold out in 2018, remastered by Devi(L)s Granziera (Teatro Satanico) and adding two previously unreleased live recordings, from Treviso in 1999 and Tokyo in 2006. ‘Paranoia’, originally Atrax Morgue’s first full-length CD album, released on Old Europa Cafe in 2000, returns in an expanded edition remastered by Devis G., adding two alternate versions of the track “Il Forcipe di Thanatos” first issued on the 2017 “Malaplacenta” 7-inch; those alternate versions stem from a 2007 recording session, the year of Corbelli’s death. ‘Pathophysiology’, first released as a 1995 cassette and reprinted on CDr in 2002 and CD in 2019, is remastered again at Sweet Slaughter for this edition, with four previously unreleased bonus tracks, two recorded in 1995 and two in 2002. Nordvargr powers new Apex Parasite and Fistfun records Swedish musician Henrik Nordvargr Björkk, known as Nordvargr, recorded and contributed vocals to Swedish power electronics act Apex Parasite‘s new album ‘Warzone Europa’, tracked at Nar Mattaru over July and August 2026. The album is released as a hand-numbered edition of 199 copies. Björkk, also known for his work with Mz.412, Folkstorm and Bøltorn, also appears on ‘Not Nice Ever’, a harsh noise collaboration released as Fistfun with Claudio Frassine, known for his projects Mademoiselle Bistouri and North Central. ‘Not Nice Ever’ follows the pair’s earlier Fistfun release “Up the Rolls” and is limited to 199 hand-numbered copies. Black Leather Jesus and The Rita round out the batch American industrial power noise project Black Leather Jesus, founded by Richard Ramirez in 1989, releases ‘Probe’ in a limited edition of 300 copies. The album’s core lineup features Sean E. Ramirez, Nathan Golub, Thomas Puopolo, Richard Ramirez, Kevin Novak, JRL, Anjilla Ulfhednar, Scott Kindberg and Domokos, with individual tracks built around guest collaborations with slowdanger, G.X. Jupitter-Larsen, Yellow Gas Flames and The Rita. The Rita, the harsh noise project of Canadian musician Sam McKinlay, credited on Discogs with originating the “harsh noise wall” style and coining the term, also gets a reissue in the batch. ‘Possessed Nun Sleaze’ was first released in 1998 on Labyrinth Recordings, in an edition of 50 cassette copies, marking The Rita’s first release on an American label. Old Europa Cafe’s CD reprint carries new artwork and is dedicated to Isabella and Sister Angela.
items._genre: power electronics / noise / dark ambient / industrial
items._cn_summary: 本文为厂牌发行资讯，涵盖Old Europa Cafe旗下四张新专辑及三张Atrax Morgue再版作品，均以限量digipak CD形式发行。内容涉及已故意大利噪音先驱Marco Corbelli的'Pathophysiology'、'Paranoia'、'Alive and Dead'三张作品的重新混音版本，附带未发表现场录音和替代混音等附加素材。瑞典音乐人Nordvargr参与Apex Parasite和Fistfun两个项目的制作，前者属于力量电子风格，后者为粗噪音合作。Black Leather Jesus与The Rita分别推出新专辑，整体偏向极端地下工业噪音美学。文中无音乐评论或艺术价值评估，仅为唱片发行信息汇编。
