items.body: Clan of Xymox, the Dutch darkwave and gothic rock project led by Ronny Moorings, released “Notes From The Underground” on 21 September 2001 through Pandaimonium Records in Europe. The album turns 25 this year. Metropolis Records issued it in North America nine days later, on 30 September 2001. Moorings wrote, recorded and mixed all twelve tracks, and produced the record with Mojca Zugna. It was the third studio album of the reformed Clan of Xymox era, after “Hidden Faces” from 1997 and “Creatures” from 1999. Three of its songs were already in circulation by the time it appeared. The “Liberty” CD single, issued by Pandaimonium on 20 October 2000 alongside the band’s double live album, carried “Liberty” together with “Number One” and “At Your Mercy”. Clan of Xymox’s ‘Notes From The Underground’ tracklist and credits The CD runs twelve tracks: “Innocent”, “I Want You Now”, “Internal Darkness”, “At Your Mercy”, “Anguish”, “Number One”, “Into Her Web”, “The Bitter Sweet”, “Liberty”, “Something Wrong”, “Mysterium” and “The Same Dream”. Dierk Budde mastered the album and Mojca Zugna made the sleeve artwork. The band’s official biography states the record reached number 2 on the German DAC chart and topped the US Musicfolio poll for 2001. The same page quotes a Side-Line review of the album as reading “This album is to be seen as a milestone in the band’s discography towards which their previous efforts all converge, or emerge from.” Pandaimonium returned to the material in May 2002 with “Remixes From The Underground”, a two-disc set that reworked every song on the album. Its contributors included Front 242, Assemblage 23, In Strict Confidence, Iris, Angels & Agony and Beborn Beton, and the limited edition added the band’s first video disc. Notes from the Underground by Clan Of Xymox About Clan of Xymox Ronny Moorings formed the band in 1981 in Nijmegen, the Netherlands. Its first release, the mini-album “Subsequent Pleasures”, appeared in 1983 in a run of 500 copies recorded on a four-track home setup. Demo material sent with it led to a deal with 4AD, and the self-titled album followed in 1985, cut at Palladium Studios in Edinburgh and co-produced with label head Ivo Watts-Russell. “Medusa” came next on the same label, and the band contributed “Muscoviet Musquito” to the 4AD compilation “Lonely Is An Eyesore” in 1987. The group parted with 4AD in October 1988, signed to Wing, a PolyGram subsidiary, and shortened its name to Xymox. “Twist of Shadows” arrived in 1989 with the singles “Obsession”, “Imagination” and “Blind Hearts”; the band’s official biography puts its sales above 300,000 copies. “Phoenix” followed in 1991 and closed the Wing chapter when PolyGram wound the label down. “Metamorphosis” and “Headclouds” then came out on the UK independent Zok Records. Moorings also wrote music for two CD-ROM games in the same period, “Total Mayhem” in 1996 and “Revenant” a year later. In 1997 Moorings ended the Xymox era, restarted the band as Clan of Xymox and signed to Tess Records. “Hidden Faces” appeared that year, produced by Dave M. Allen and John A. Rivers. “Creatures” followed in 1999, mixed by Rivers and Moorings, and moved the band to Metropolis Records in North America and Pandaimonium Records in Europe, the pairing that would also handle “Notes From The Underground”. The double live album “LIVE”, drawn from the band’s South and Central American shows, came out in October 2000. “Farewell” arrived in 2003, and “The Best Of Clan Of Xymox”, with its running order chosen by a fan poll, in September 2004. The “Weak In My Knees” EP opened 2006 ahead of the album “Breaking Point”. In early 2009 the band moved to Trisol Records in Europe while staying with Metropolis in the United States, and “In Love We Trust” came out on 18 August 2009, covered in Clan of Xymox’s ‘In Love We Trust’ turns 17 on 18 August. The thirteenth studio album “Darkest Hour” followed on 20 May 2011, the covers set “Kindred Spirits” in October 2012 and “Matters Of Mind, Body And Soul” on 14 February 2014. “Days Of Black” arrived on 7 April 2017, reported in Clan Of Xymox return with new album: ‘Days Of Black’. “Spider On The Wall” followed in 2020, announced in New Clan Of Xymox album ‘Spider On The Wall’ and video for ‘All I Ever Know’, and Moorings talked through his writing that September in Interview with Clan Of Xymox: ‘For Me A Lot Of These Memories Are Finished Stories Without A Soundtrack’. “Limbo”, written during the pandemic lockdowns, arrived in July 2021 and was previewed in Clan Of Xymox returns with all new album ‘Limbo’ in July. The eighteenth album “Exodus” followed in June 2024, reported in Clan Of Xymox announce new album for June: ‘Exodus’, with the “Blood of Christ” EP later that year and a 3CD edition of “Exodus” in February 2025. Moorings looked back across the full run in Ronny Moorings (Clan Of Xymox), an exclusive retrospective interview. Moorings has been the only constant member and still writes, records and produces the band’s music. The live line-up is Moorings on vocals, guitar and melodica, Mojca Zugna on bass, Mario Usai on guitar and bass, and Sean Winzer on keyboards, synth drums and backing vocals. Twenty-five years on, “Notes From The Underground” sits between “Creatures” and “Farewell” in that sequence.
items._cn_summary: 本文为Clan of Xymox 2001年专辑《Notes From The Underground》发行25周年的纪念性资讯文章，主要回顾了该专辑的发行背景、厂牌信息、曲目列表、制作人员及乐队历史沿革。文章并未对专辑的音乐风格、编曲特征或艺术成就进行实质性分析，仅引用了一条简短的评价称其为乐队曲目演变中的里程碑。文字内容以事实陈述为主，缺乏对声音设计、创作手法或文化语境层面的深入探讨。文章虽涉及暗潮类型，但停留在信息整理层面，未展现评论的独立观点或审美判断，对希望了解专辑音乐实质的读者帮助有限。整体属于资讯性回顾文本，乐评价值较低。

items.body: In August 1819, tens of thousands of working men and women gathered in St. Peter�s Field in Manchester to hear the politician Henry Hunt speak. They were difficult times, many still out of work after the Napoleonic wars, rising prices and low wages � and always those at the bottom of the heap suffering. Hunt was a famed orator, a man on the side of the people, able to stir and inspire with his voice. Although the gathering was peaceful, the size of the crowd terrified the magistrates, who panicked and imagined an uprising. They sent in half-trained dragoons and the cavalry, who rode down, slashed and killed without compunction or compassion. In the end, 18 died and up to 700 were wounded. It was a stain on the nation, an outrage; prompting Percy Shelley, one of the poetic giants of the age, to write The Masque of Anarchy , with its famous lines: �Rise like Lions after slumber / in unvanquishable number / She your chains to earth like dew / Which in sleep had fallen on you / Ye are many - they are few.� Peterloo, as people called it, remains one of the seminal events in English working-class history, one that Sean Cooney of the Young 'Uns has revisited for this album of original songs, which is lavishly presented in a book with contemporary letters, political cartoons and illustrations to create a multimedia event. It�s ambitious, no doubt about that, and he�s selected some great talent to help � guitarist Sam Carter, the almost ubiquitous fiddler/singer Eliza Carthy, Ben Nicholls supplying background and texture on various instruments, and the Lancashire industrial ballad singer Jennifer Reid, who doubles as narrator. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid For a small ensemble, they make a powerful noise. The songs capture the feel of the day; the anticipation and excitement at the summer gathering, the joy that turns to terror and flight as the troops charge, then the bitter, mournful aftermath, voiced some powerful melodies and very well-chosen images. As a writer, Cooney often focuses on the personal in the small tales of people like �Sam Bamford� and �Mary Fildes,� while the three short pieces that comprise �The Monkey Rides The Mare� capture the bluster and arrogance of the soldiers. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid Cooney is a persuasive singer, and on this heartfelt project, he puts plenty of emotion into his voice. Having two other outstanding vocalists alongside him makes for a wonderful triple threat. In these days when governments across the world are cracking down on protest, this stands as a sobering and very timely reminder. It�s a history lesson, yes, but the detail of the history stays in the book, while the music creates a set of songs that will resonate and remain for a long time. Find the artist online. Further reading: The Young'uns - Tiny Notes (Review) Ben Nicholls - Duets
items.label: Hudson
items._cn_summary: 这是一张以1819年英国彼得卢屠杀为题材的概念民谣专辑，Sean Cooney以原创歌曲重建这一工人阶级历史事件。专辑以书籍形式呈现，辅以当代信件、政治漫画与插图，融合文字与音乐形成多媒体体验。参与的音乐人包括歌手Eliza Carthy、吉他手Sam Carter及工业民谣歌手Jennifer Reid，后者还担任旁白。歌曲从夏集会的期待写到骑兵冲入人群的恐怖，再延伸至悲恸余波，配器虽精简却层次丰富，叙事聚焦于Sam Bamford、Mary Fildes等普通人的命运。Cooney的演唱情感充沛，与两位嗓音出色的歌手形成三人合力。该项目在当下全球压制抗议的背景下具有现实回响，但其音乐语言基本立足于英伦民谣传统，未涉及显著的实验性或跨类型融合。

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items._cn_summary: 这张现场专辑记录了Dr. John在德国洛雷莱露天剧场的演出，乐队由吉他、贝斯和鼓组成紧凑四人编制。演出以新奥尔良经典曲目为主，包括Mardi Gras游行歌曲《Iko Iko》、带有迷幻放克色彩的《I Walk on Guilded Splinters》，以及他本人的代表作《Right Place, Wrong Time》。文章着重描述了现场氛围、舞台所在的莱茵河文化遗产地理环境，以及音乐家横跨布鲁斯、灵魂乐、放克和新奥尔良传统的表演方式。整体内容偏向传统的新奥尔良节奏蓝调与放克风格回顾，属于较为经典的根源音乐演出档案，与实验、前卫或电子方向关联较弱。

items._cn_summary: Ezra Collective 的第四张专辑以一个问题为核心：为何如此多源自苦难的非裔音乐让人起舞。主唱 Femi Koleoso 在获得 Mercury Prize 和 BRIT Award 之后，发现观众专门为感受快乐而来，而他们个人生活与周遭世界却正经历伤痛，专辑试图在舞台上制造欢乐与现实困境之间寻找答案。文章本身为新闻稿式简介，并非完整乐评，主要介绍专辑背景与创作动机，未对具体音乐手法、曲式结构或声音实验进行深入分析。整体内容以乐团此前成就和情感叙事为主，缺乏关于音色、编制、即兴或录音工艺的讨论，无法为读者提供对音乐本体的判断依据。

items.body: Review by sgtpepper — Alan Parsons Project continued with their prolific album production in 1979. Despite the concept album being out of favour in the time of more superficial music styles (disco, punk) the band holds on to what they do best - clever songwriting, a couple of well arranged instrumentals and heart-broken ballads. "The Lucifer" offers a promising mildly progressive start loaded with synths. The funky "You lie down with dogs" follows, splendid vocal harmonies and live instrumentation. "I'd rather be a man" is the hardest rocking and loudest song on this release. My main interests in this song lie in the rhythm section (bass). "You won't be there" is a melancholic track which would suit to any post-Beatle 70's output but mainly George.After that, the output gets less memorable and unique, for 2 or songs yet it remains pleasant. "Don't hold back" is a simple catchy pop song.But now we're coming to the brilliant two tracks - the Beach Boys magic loaded "Secret gardens", an instrumental with the melody as strong as the sweeping vocal arrangements and atmosphere a la Pet Sounds. After this level of sophistication, we're faced by one of the strongest APP ballads with dreamy melancholic lyrics and fitting music underscoring the message.Lesley Duncan vocal was a great choice as was the mighty church organ chords which evoke the sense of helplessness in me.Recommended to fans of progressive and well executed pop.
items._genre: crossover prog / art pop / soft rock
items._cn_summary: Alan Parsons Project 1979年专辑延续其精致的制作路线，以概念专辑形式对抗当时盛行的迪斯科与朋克潮流。专辑以合成器开场，逐步引入放克节奏、忧伤抒情曲与器乐作品。亮点在于融合海滩男孩式和声编排的器乐段落，以及以教堂管风琴营造无助感的抒情曲。Lesley Duncan的人声选择为专辑增添了柔美层次。整体制作精良、编曲考究，但音乐风格偏向主流艺术流行与轻摇滚，在实验性、前卫性方面较为保守，与用户偏好的实验前卫、自由爵士、电子及暗潮等方向存在较大距离，属于旋律优美但缺乏突破性的成熟商业制作。

items.body: Review by ZowieZiggy — D(evice) - V(oice) - D(rum). or DVD...On this live release, Livgren will not be playing, unfortunately.When looking at the track list, the veteran Kansas fans must be very pleased : several of their anthems are played and lots of good songs are featured as well.In terms of old song, "Belexes" the first track (if you exclude the intro) brings us back to their first release. It is not my fave one from this very good DVD. But it was probably a hint to the audience that they were going to get a very nice Kansas night. And indeed they will! One song could have been avoided without hurting the ensemble : "The Preacher" that I really can't stand (this choir stuff is just too much). Some other ones are just below par, like "Fight Fire with Fire" and "Play the Game Tonight". My favorite songs on this live DVD do belong to their long ones. Both "Icarus", "Song for America" of course (my all time fave), "Journey from Mariabronn", "Cheyenne Anthem","Miracles Out of Nowhere (6:31), The fabulous meddley "Portrait/Pinnacle" & even the extended "Carry on Wayward Son" (just below 10 minutes).This DVD is very good.One can see how the audience likes it, enjoys it and participates.Only a few great songs are missing ("Incomudro") , and Walsh's voice is not always super. Those are the little defects. Four stars.
items._cn_summary: 这张DVD是Kansas乐队前成员组成的Device项目的现场演出录制，收录了多首Kansas经典曲目如《Icarus》《Song for America》《Journey from Mariabronn》等长篇作品，以及长达近十分钟的扩展版《Carry on Wayward Son》。演出中观众参与度高，气氛活跃，但缺少乐队核心成员Livgren的参与，部分曲目如《The Preacher》的合唱部分显得冗余，Walsh的嗓音表现也不够稳定。作为交响前卫摇滚的现场专辑，整体偏向怀旧向的经典曲目重演，与实验性、前卫即兴或电子融合类音乐相距甚远。

items.body: Black Sherif takes his own sound apart on SUN SHERIF, the six-track EP he released through Blacko Management and EMPIRE in early September. The Konongo-born singer and rapper calls it “a deconstruction of everything Black Sherif’s done sonically“, a method that gives him the obsession he says he needs when working through fifteen or twenty demos at a time. That sound took shape on the “First Sermon” and “Second Sermon” singles of 2021, Twi verses set over highlife melody and UK drill drums, and in 2022 “Kwaku the Traveller” carried it to number one on Apple Music in Ghana and Nigeria. Two albums followed, The Villain I Never Was in 2022 and Iron Boy in April 2025. The EP brings in the Ghanaian singer AratheJay on “Forever” and the Trinidadian production duo Full Blown on “Love Again”, and Sherif sings “Jolie” alone, moving between Twi and English towards a chorus built on the French word for pretty. The verses are made of small acts of devotion: a New Year’s drive to her door, songs written for her in the manner of Kurt Cobain, a habit dropped because she disliked it. Listen to “Jolie” HERE and stream SUN SHERIF following THIS LINK The post Daily Discovery: Black Sherif – Jolie appeared first on Rhythm Passport.

items.body: The chorus of “Don’t Try” turns an old piece of street wisdom into a hook: “Don’t try piss on me and tell me it’s raining”. The man it is aimed at takes the credit for work he did not do, hands out promises that come to nothing, expects the overtime as standard and treats one late morning as an offence. Past him stand all the others: the smile that turns into a betrayal, the boasting about how easily things arrive, the liberties taken without a second thought. The last verse hands the accusation back, on the old line about the three fingers that point home whenever one goes out. Messenjah open Social Commentary with it, seven tracks of reggae made with The Aarons Brothers and released on Reload Records in April 2025. They have played roots reggae since forming in Kitchener, Ontario in 1981, and became the first Canadian reggae band signed to a major label when Warner Music Canada took Rock You High and put the music on national radio here for the first time. That was the second door Rupert “Ojiji” Harvey had opened, after Crack of Dawn, the Toronto soul group he co-founded, became the first Black Canadian band to sign a major deal. He has led Messenjah since the mid-1980s, through Reggae Sunsplash in Montego Bay, a Juno for Catch De Vibe, and a night in 1998 playing for Nelson Mandela at Toronto’s SkyDome. Hear “Don’t Try” HERE and pick up Social Commentary through THIS LINK The post Daily Discovery: Messenjah & The Aarons Brothers – Don’t Try appeared first on Rhythm Passport.
items._cn_summary: Messenjah 是一支来自加拿大安大略省的根源雷鬼乐队，自1981年成立以来一直坚持雷鬼路线。主唱 Rupert "Ojiji" Harvey 曾联合创立多伦多灵魂乐团 Crack of Dawn，也是首位签约大型唱片公司的加拿大黑人乐队成员。本文聚焦的单曲 "Don't Try" 以一句街头俗语作为副歌钩子，讽刺那些窃取他人功劳、空许诺言、对加班习以为常的人，副歌歌词直白犀利。歌词层面延续了传统雷鬼的社会批判传统，末段引用经典的"三根手指指向自己"说法完成回击。专辑《Social Commentary》共七首曲目，与 The Aarons Brothers 合作制作，2025年4月由 Reload Records 发行。乐队曾获 Juno 奖，并曾在1998年为曼德拉演出。整体属于传统根源雷鬼范畴，与实验、爵士、电子等偏好方向距离较远。

items.body: chauncey, a Minneapolis-based synth-led alt-pop artist, released the single “Terrible Idea” on September 11, 2026. The chauncey “Terrible Idea” single is the first release from the seven-track album “Life of the Party,” due September 25, 2026. chauncey brings a synth-led alt-pop sound that mixes bright, impulsive hooks with a quieter, more reflective register, moving between crowded-room energy and the silence that follows once everyone has gone home. chauncey’s ‘Life of the Party’ album and ‘Terrible Idea’ “Life of the Party” traces a single night out, opening on anticipation and the people encountered along the way before turning to impulsive decisions and their comedown. chauncey has described the record as building toward “the empty room at the end,” once the crowd has gone. “Terrible Idea” takes on the impulsive side of that story, while “Permission” and “When Everybody Leaves” follow the aftermath, with the latter closing the record as the lights come back on. About chauncey chauncey is a Minneapolis-based artist who makes synth-led alt-pop, writing about crowded rooms, bad decisions and the quiet that sets in once everyone has gone. chauncey has kept the project’s origin story thin by choice, preferring the songs over a biography to do the introducing, and has summed up the approach as being a “kid with a synth.” The seven-track debut album “Life of the Party,” due September 25, 2026, follows a single night out from its opening rush to its final empty room. “Terrible Idea,” released September 11, 2026, is the album’s first single; “Permission” and “When Everybody Leaves” are among its other focus tracks. chauncey is based in Minneapolis.
items._cn_summary: Minneapolis艺术家chauncey发布了七曲专辑《Life of the Party》的首支单曲《Terrible Idea》，专辑以合成器为主导，定位为另类流行。整张专辑围绕一个夜晚外出展开，从开场的期待与人群相遇，到冲动决定及其低落后果，最终收束于散场后的空荡房间。《Terrible Idea》聚焦于冲动的瞬间，《Permission》和《When Everybody Leaves》则处理事后的余波，后者作为终曲呼应灯光重新亮起。制作上混合明亮的钩子和内省的安静段落，呈现喧嚣人群与独处沉默之间的张力。艺术家刻意保持身份背景模糊，以"一个玩合成器的孩子"概括自身风格，让作品本身先行。从音乐语言来看，这是一张结构规整的合成器流行专辑，旋律明亮，制作清洁，与实验性、前卫性或暗潮类听感有较远距离。

items.body:
Tiny Sun creates tiny songs that give off light and heat well out of proportion to their size. Composed, performed, and produced by Martina Sorbara, Jonathan Goldsmith, and Don Rooke, the record is vaguely Americana, with plucked guitars and ukuleles, chiming keyboards, and the lonesome slide of the guitar.
Vanishment
contains eighteen sparkling miniatures - that take a scant 34 minutes to negotiate - notable for their economy of arrangement and the subtle directness of the lyrics. The tracks glow with Martina�s clear, high, and sometimes fragile voice.
The songs are about loss: lost love, lost confidence, but sometimes about resignation to the enigmatic quirks of the world. The tone of wry fatalism mirrors the fact that this project is the work of many years of collaboration and email exchanges while the trio pursued their musical day jobs. Jonathan Goldsmith is an award-winning composer for television and film, Don Rooke fronts the Toronto roots band The Henrys, and Martina Sorbara is known for folk, electropop, and her band Dragonette.
Kerosene Madrigal
The range of backgrounds leads to many styles, and the record betrays interesting influences. The opening track, �Kerosene Madrigal,� is a sort of miner�s blues reminiscent of Michelle Shocked. The soul-country of �Imagined Love� reminded me of fellow Torontonians Cowboy Junkies, especially the sweet organ. The stoic and twangy �Don�t Fault the Stars for Falling� could have been a Dolly Parton tune.
A Grand Expanse
�A Grand Expanse� has a more ambitious arrangement.  It sounds like the end-credits song from a long-ago film we only vaguely remember. It says everything it needs to in one minute and twenty seconds and exactly 38 words. It is quintessential Tiny Sun.
The entire recording feels like music from a dream, and since no one knows exactly what dream music sounds like, this could be it.
Berceuse
Tiny Sun will perform the entire album at Toronto�s Koerner Hall on May 14, 2026.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由三位多伦多音乐人远程协作完成，包含十八首短小的民谣小品，总时长仅三十四分钟。编曲以原声吉他、尤克里里琴、滑音吉他和键盘为主，风格大致属于美式民谣范畴，带有乡村布鲁斯和灵魂乡村的痕迹。歌词聚焦于失去、放手和宿命感，演唱者嗓音清亮高亢，略显脆弱。专辑整体呈现出梦境般的朦胧氛围，编曲简洁克制，旋律含蓄内敛。然而，从创新性和跨类型融合角度来看，这张作品基本停留在传统民谣的框架内，虽然三位音乐人各自拥有丰富的背景，但成品并未将这些资源转化为实验性或前卫性的探索，整体偏向精致的独立民谣小品集。
